name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Cloud-based customer support helpdesk with REST APIs for tickets, contacts and conversations.
auth_notes: Each agent has a personal API key used as the username of HTTP Basic auth, with any dummy password (curl -u apikey:X). No OAuth is described on the fetched pages.
access_notes: The key is viewed from Profile Settings after a captcha check and is shown only when the agent is verified. Plan or cost gating for API access is not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve personal API key and documented JSON REST API with rate-limit headers. Plan-level API access rules are not stated on the fetched pages, so confirm before building.
